clocks.kev_date_added: CISA KEV dateAdded as NVD mirrors it in `cisaExploitAdd`. The mirror lags CISA; it is not the date of first exploitation.
clocks.published: NVD `published`, truncated to the UTC date.
clocks.release_date: releaseDate as reported by Jamf's patch catalog. Not a claim about when the vendor made the release available.
clocks.severity: Today's score: CVSS v3.1, else v4.0, else v2, NVD's Primary entry first. No score history is held.

definitions.branch: A release line is the first BRANCH_COMPONENTS components of a version. A range is branch-ambiguous when it matches catalog releases on a line other than its fixed version's: the fix for that other line cannot be read from the range.
definitions.candidates: CVEs whose NVD configurations name the product's CPE pair, plus CVEs with no configurations whose CNA affected block names the product. RULED 2026-10-02: the second kind is excluded and counted, never placed from the CNA block; another source of ranges is a later benchmark, added beside this one.
definitions.critical_or_kev: TABLED 2026-10-02, not ruled: do not quote this row. As computed, a release is installed on the first day a CVE it fixes is KEV-listed or critical, and never before Jamf reports the release. No score history is held, so today's NVD score stands in for the score on that day and a critical CVE triggers on its publication date.
definitions.exposure_days: Days on or after publication on which the installed version is inside an affected range: the fixing release's install date minus the publication date, cut off at the window's last day when no fix was installed (`open_at_window_end`).
definitions.fixed_version: An excluded range end is the fixed version. After an inclusive end or an exact version it is the next catalog release on the same line that no range of the CVE matches.
definitions.install: RULED 2026-10-02. A policy of D days installs each catalog release by the D-th day, and the day Jamf reports the release is day one: the install date is the reported date + (D - 1) days. One update event per day on which the installed version rises.
definitions.never: The device stays on the version that was current when the window opened.
definitions.never_seen: The device ran no affected version on or after the CVE's NVD publication date: the fixing release was installed on or before that date, or the versions it ran were never inside an affected range (`never_seen_outside_affected_range`).
definitions.path: RULED 2026-10-02: the policy numbers are `hold`, a per-line Jamf title — the device stays at or below the line current when the window opened. `latest` follows the newest release across lines (Jamf's combined definition) and is the alternative.
definitions.prerelease: A criterion `parse.py` reads as naming a pre-release (`4.4.9:rc0`) is not applied to a release build; it is counted in `criteria_skipped`.
definitions.steady_state: A D-day device opens the window on the newest release whose install date had already passed. `never` and `critical_or_kev` open it on the newest release Jamf had reported by the window's first day.
